sentence: Draws a random pick order for the group once, then members take turns in snake order choosing from a fixed list of options until a pick limit is reached.
use_when: A group needs to split up or choose plans from a short list by taking turns
Fair, random turn order is wanted for picking activities, places or items
Each option should go to only one person
Planning an outing where everyone gets a say
dont_use_when: The group wants to vote and count preferences on options (use a poll)
Options need to be added or edited by members freely
Everyone should pick at the same time or pick more than one option each without turns
